calculation.method: Only existing complete type-profile reports with identical member size/pre/post SHA are read. No SQLite source values are read this turn.
calculation.native_reference: For single-table reports, profile.scanned_value_bytes is that table's complete observed SQLite API payload bytes. For a multi-table report, use the whole report total as a conservative table upper reference; flag not exact.
calculation.row_frames: native payload bytes + 13*rows + NULL_count + 9*TEXT_count + INTEGER_count + REAL_count
calculation.temp_reference_bound: 3*row frame bytes, conservative live-file payload bound for existing sorter; not filesystem allocation or future measured peak
calculation.maximum_based_bounds: Separately preserved maxima-times-count upper bounds are deliberately loose, not observed stream sizes.
calculation.units: bytes; SQLite API UTF-8 bytes, not original page encoding
calculation.excluded: No business values, source PK uniqueness, database equality, runtime forecasts, filesystem atomicity or full Task8 claims

proposed_common_runtime.resource_breach_action: Cancel only the named one-shot evidence container; retain incomplete metadata, stop later batches; no automatic budget increase or retry
proposed_common_runtime.stage_transition: Continue small -> medium -> large only after previous batch has complete source results, successful source digest checks and owned scratch cleanup

proposed_groups.scratch: Disk-backed private directory under configured runtime root; byte ledger <=1GiB; not tmpfs

expected_hash_read_bytes.caveat: Approximately 95.5 decimal GB logical reads, not new copies or guaranteed physical disk I/O; filesystem cache may satisfy reads. Additional SQLite page and sort read/write I/O not included.

next_change_if_approved: Extend existing inspect-sqlite-values.py to consume SHA-bound scope/budget, validate per-object ceilings and complete columns, while preserving old canary defaults and source-only atomic draft output. Package scopes in candidate images, verify synthetic safety failures and whole suite before 3 sequential real source-only batches.
